correctness.rationale: The total output weight is exactly q²(q+2)/3; every source deletion set has weight≥1 by the complete palindromic/no-palindrome dichotomy. Disjoint code shadows thus give the upper bound. Equality requires single-output period-two parents for every palindromic triple and three-output words xbybz for other triples; these are exactly q independent directed triple systems. The known DTS existence theorem establishes the claimed infinite equality range. The packaged standard-library checker verifies explicit perfect partitions for q=3,4,6,7,9 and the local weight inequality for all q≤6; none is substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: Chee–Li–Zhang (2015) already give the matching length-five burst code construction and achievable size, and it is explicitly credited. The new claims are universal sharpness against every length-five burst code and classification/count of all equality codes. Their Section III-B proves an inclusion in the spectrum of perfect code sizes, not global maximality or equality rigidity. The positive-weight upper bound and forced-DTS classification are proved independently here; no inspected prior theorem implies those upgrades. Unindexed historical priority remains a risk.

value.rationale: The substantial new contribution is to make a known infinite-family construction provably *globally* maximal in the original code space and to classify all codes meeting the sharp bound; a positive fractional packing certificate and equality analysis force independent DTS structure, producing a precise extremizer count. The construction itself is prior work and not valued as new.
